title: Cannot sign in to one app only
symptom: User can sign in to everything except one business application
user_description: Email, files, Teams, everything works. But the finance system keeps saying my login is wrong.

options.text: Reset his main password straight away
options.why: His main password clearly works elsewhere, so resetting it will not fix this and may cause more problems.

options.text: Give him admin rights in the app
options.why: Gives far more power than needed and does not address why he cannot sign in.

options.text: Confirm his main account works elsewhere, check he has access or a licence for that app, clear any saved login or try a private window, and check whether the app has an outage
options.why: Because everything else works, the fault is specific to the app. Checking access and licence, old saved logins and outages covers the usual causes.
Never the first step. It would not fix an access issue with one application.

hints: Everything else works, so where is the problem?
What does an app need in addition to a working login?
Could the app itself be having a problem?
real_world_tip: Ask if the problem is the same on another computer or browser. It quickly tells you whether it is the account or the device.
